source_target_rule: Direct source iff platform_route callsite; its Cedar source_company is empty constant. Platform-derived source iff derived_source callsite and target Company is the exact signed credential org_id, nonnil/nonplatform. Wrapper rejects before old upgrade classification. Cedar independently requires matching call_site, company kind and key == source_company; all other derived target kinds deny. Source Company key comes from verified claims, never requested target.
private_cedar_semantics: Private current-policy eligibility only. Actual bound or historical_unbound mode, original action/use/facts, one evaluation. Composite sole public decision first Denies invalid raw material or Cedar deny/error/diagnostic; diagnostic-free permit becomes Allow for validated bound or historical ReadProjection, UpgradeRequired for historical Effect/ContextMint. Never synthesize bound mode/family or duplicate privileged-role predicate.
